headline: Revenue accelerates and profitability swings sharply higher
summary_short: MasTec reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $4,374M, up 14.2% q/q and 23.4% y/y, with net income surging to $130M (+113.9% q/q, +51.7% y/y) and diluted EPS of $1.65.
summary_long: Revenue was $4,374M, +14.2% q/q and +23.4% y/y. Gross margin was ~12.7%, up modestly from ~12.5% q/q and ~12.3% y/y. EBITDA rose to $365M (+41.9% q/q, +36.4% y/y); operating income $226M (+59.5% q/q, +43.1% y/y). Net income climbed to $130M (+113.9% q/q, +51.7% y/y); diluted EPS was $1.65 (+114.3% q/q, +51.4% y/y). Cash rose to $316M (+15.3% q/q, +65.2% y/y); shareholders' equity increased to $3,477M (+5.1% q/q, +18.0% y/y).
